- Kept hero copy, metadata, and primary actions aligned with the reference layout.
- Changed notification metadata from the inaccurate “New arrival” label to “Trending now,” matching the actual endpoint data.
- Rebuilt the production frontend successfully and verified no build regressions.
- Backend API and persistence behavior remain unchanged and green.
